proxy_unattended.verdict_note: This DOWNGRADES the 2026-10-29 structural inference. The kernel that owns 127.0.0.1:7877 was not started at boot; it was started 1.2 s after the Clash GUI launched.

timeline.event: Event 6006 - clean shutdown of previous session
Interactive logon (Win32_LogonSession type 2, user 15690); MyClashHelperService PID 6356 starts
MyClash.exe (GUI) starts in session 1; Cloak.lock written in user profile
MyClashCore.exe starts as child of helper service, session 0, binds 127.0.0.1:7877

negative_evidence: The kernel start is 31 min 21 s AFTER boot and only 1.2 s after the GUI start - the causal chain GUI -> helper service -> kernel is the only sequence consistent with the timestamps.
No Service Control Manager event exists at 09:20, so this was not a service restart (only 7045 install events on 2026-09-30 and 2026-10-23, plus one 7034 unexpected stop on 2026-10-23).
No Application-log crash record exists for MyClashCore.exe in the last 7 days, which argues against 'the kernel was running since boot and crashed'.
The helper service has no failure actions, so a silently dead kernel would never be restarted by SCM.
still_unknown: Whether the helper service can spawn the kernel on demand WITHOUT any GUI request (single boot sample only).
Behaviour after a real logoff (not tested - it would terminate this session).
Behaviour after resume from hibernation with Fast Startup enabled (HiberbootEnabled=1).
BitLocker state of D: (query blocked for non-elevated session).
proxy_unattended.practical_consequence: Inventory discovery uses Playwright through SCRAPER_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:7877. If 7877 is only alive while the interactive GUI session runs, then an unattended service would start with no proxy and every discovery run would fail with ERR_PROXY_CONNECTION_FAILED. The service design must gate on proxy reachability or accept that it only runs while the console session exists.
proxy_unattended.separate_egress_note: This agent session also carries HTTP_PROXY=127.0.0.1:63440 (host-managed). That is a different egress from the production SCRAPER_PROXY=7877. A Session-0 service inherits neither.

bridge_runtime.finding: The supervisor last ran 2026-10-29 22:40-22:54 and produced no shutdown or crash record, then never came back. Today's logon at 08:48 did not restart it despite the Run entry.
